about: Known-answer set for the bundle model-swap check (lane B, 2026-10-21). Every answer is fixed by the seed below, so any model handed brainContext(bundle) should give it. 'exact' answers are compared after lowercasing and trimming punctuation; 'contains' answers must appear in the answer. The last question's fact sits only in a QUARANTINED note: it must not reach the model, so the right answer is unknown.
